about.title: About Us
about.subtitle: Your trusted partner for premium computer peripherals

about.expertSupportDesc: Dedicated team ready to help you
about.missionDesc: To deliver high-quality computer peripherals that enhance productivity and gaming experiences for customers worldwide.
about.missionText1: We source and manufacture only the best quality computer peripherals, ensuring every product meets our high standards.
about.missionText2: From pre-sales consultation to after-sales support, we're committed to providing an outstanding customer experience.
about.storyParagraph1: Founded in 2014, TechTrade Pro started as a small computer accessories manufacturer in Shenzhen, China. Over the past decade, we've grown into a trusted global supplier of premium computer peripherals.
about.storyParagraph2: Our product range includes mechanical keyboards, gaming mice, headsets, mouse pads, and other computer accessories. We serve customers in over 50 countries, from individual gamers to enterprise clients.
about.storyParagraph3: We believe in building long-term partnerships with our customers. That's why we invest heavily in quality control, customer service, and continuous product improvement.
about.readyToWorkDesc: Join thousands of satisfied customers worldwide. Get in touch with our team today.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Your privacy is important to us. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your personal information when you use our website and services.

informationWeCollect.title: Information We Collect
informationWeCollect.p1: We collect information you provide directly to us, such as when you create an account, place an order, or contact us for support.
informationWeCollect.p2: This may include your name, email address, phone number, shipping address, and payment information.
informationWeCollect.p3: We also automatically collect certain information when you visit our website, including your IP address, browser type, and pages viewed.

howWeUse.title: How We Use Your Information
howWeUse.p1: We use the information we collect to process your orders, provide customer support, and improve our products and services.
howWeUse.p2: We may also use your information to send you promotional emails about new products, special offers, or other updates.
howWeUse.p3: You can opt out of receiving marketing emails at any time by clicking the unsubscribe link in any email.

dataProtection.title: Data Protection
dataProtection.p1: We implement appropriate security measures to protect your personal information against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction.
dataProtection.p2: We use industry-standard encryption technologies when transferring and receiving sensitive data.
dataProtection.p3: However, no method of transmission over the Internet is 100% secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.p1: We use cookies and similar tracking technologies to enhance your browsing experience and analyze our traffic.
cookies.p2: You can control cookies through your browser settings, but disabling cookies may affect some features of our website.
cookies.p3: We use both session cookies (which expire when you close your browser) and persistent cookies (which stay on your device for a set period).

thirdParty.title: Third-Party Services
thirdParty.p1: We may share your information with third-party service providers who assist us in operating our website and serving you.
thirdParty.p2: These include payment processors, shipping partners, and email service providers.
thirdParty.p3: We require all third-party providers to protect your information and use it only for the purposes we specify.

yourRights.title: Your Rights
yourRights.p1: You have the right to access, correct, or delete your personal information at any time.
yourRights.p2: You can also request that we restrict processing of your data or object to certain uses.
yourRights.p3: To exercise these rights, please contact us using the information provided below.

childrensPrivacy.title: Children's Privacy
childrensPrivacy.p1: Our website is not intended for children under the age of 13.
childrensPrivacy.p2: We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13.
childrensPrivacy.p3: If you believe we have collected information from a child, please contact us immediately.

changes.title: Changes to This Policy
changes.p1: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time.
changes.p2: We will notify you of any changes by posting the new policy on this page with an updated date.
changes.p3: We encourage you to review this Privacy Policy periodically.

contactUs.title: Contact Us
contactUs.p1: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us at privacy@techtradepro.com.
contactUs.p2: You can also reach us by mail at the address provided on our Contact page.
contactUs.p3: We will respond to your inquiry within 24 business hours.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Find answers to common questions about our products and services.
faq.stillHaveQuestionsDesc: Our customer support team is here to help you.

q1.question: How do I place an order?
q1.answer: Simply browse our products, add items to your cart, and proceed to checkout. You'll need to provide your shipping address and payment information.

q2.question: Can I modify or cancel my order?
q2.answer: You can modify or cancel your order within 24 hours of placing it, as long as it hasn't been shipped yet. Please contact our customer service team for assistance.

q3.question: What payment methods do you accept?
q3.answer: We accept major credit cards (Visa, MasterCard), PayPal, Stripe, and bank transfers for wholesale orders.

q1.question: How long does shipping take?
q1.answer: Standard shipping takes 7-15 business days for most countries. Express shipping takes 3-7 business days. Delivery times may vary depending on your location.

q2.question: Do you offer free shipping?
q2.answer: Yes! We offer free standard shipping on orders over $99 USD worldwide.

q3.question: Do you ship internationally?
q3.answer: Yes, we ship to over 100 countries worldwide. You can check if we ship to your country during checkout.

q1.question: Is my payment information secure?
q1.answer: Yes, we use industry-standard SSL encryption to protect your payment information. We never store your full credit card details on our servers.

q2.question: What currency are prices in?
q2.answer: All prices are listed in US Dollars (USD). Your bank may convert the amount to your local currency.

q3.question: Do I need to pay import duties or taxes?
q3.answer: Import duties and taxes may apply depending on your country's regulations. These charges are the buyer's responsibility.

q1.question: What is your return policy?
q1.answer: We offer a 30-day return policy for most products. Items must be in their original condition and packaging to be eligible for a return.

q2.question: How do I return a product?
q2.answer: Please contact our customer service team to initiate a return. We'll provide you with a return authorization number and shipping instructions.

q3.question: How long does it take to get a refund?
q3.answer: Once we receive and inspect your returned item, we'll process your refund within 5-7 business days. The refund will be issued to your original payment method.

q1.question: Are your products genuine?
q1.answer: Yes, all products we sell are 100% genuine and come with the manufacturer's warranty. We source directly from authorized distributors and manufacturers.

q2.question: Do products come with a warranty?
q2.answer: Most products come with a 12-month warranty from the date of purchase. Some products may have longer warranty periods. Please check the product page for specific warranty information.

q3.question: Can I get a sample before ordering in bulk?
q3.answer: Yes, we offer sample orders for wholesale customers. Please contact our sales team for sample pricing and availability.

q1.question: How do I create an account?
q1.answer: Click on the 'Register' link in the top menu and fill in the registration form with your email address and password.

q2.question: I forgot my password. What should I do?
q2.answer: Click on 'Forgot password?' on the login page and enter your email address. We'll send you a password reset link.
